channel.title: LC Insight
channel.description: Read the chain, not the rumors. Crypto market news and on-chain analysis.

item.title: Canada proposes barring banks from issuing stablecoins directly. Subsidiaries only
item.description: Budget 2026 proposes to bar federally regulated banks, trust companies and insurers from issuing stablecoins themselves. They would have to use a separate non-financial subsidiary that the Bank of Canada supervises.

item.title: BitMine bought 9,587 more ether, but its staking income estimate fell $49 million in a week
item.description: BitMine Immersion now reports 6,070,092 ETH. It staked no new coins this week, its yield estimate slipped, and ether's drop since its count has cut about $870 million off the pile's value.

item.title: Sharks bought $36.4 million of RLUSD in a day. Over the week, whales sold $12 million net
item.description: Two wallets made 37 trades in Ripple's stablecoin in 24 hours. One of them, with $97 million on DeepSea, swaps it in blocks of up to $4.5 million.

item.title: Sharks sold $19 million of gold tokens in a day, a day after buying $8.1 million of XAUt
item.description: A handful of big wallets sold $10.5 million of PAXG and $8.5 million of Tether Gold and bought back $2.8 million. Both tokens slipped about 0.9%.

item.title: 23 influencer wallets bought $555,000 of two new memecoins in a day. No priced sales
item.description: The same 23 BNB Chain KOL wallets piled into 狗狗币 and spyless within about two hours. CoinGecko does not list either token.

item.title: Smart money trader SMffa1 made $13.8 million in a week, 40% of its $34.3 million wallet
item.description: DeepSea ranks SMffa1 No. 3 on Hyperliquid this week. At 6:45 a.m. ET its live trades were in stock-price markets such as LITE, SKHY and SOXL, not crypto.

item.title: Super Inu (SI) jumps 164% in a day, a week after a 97% crash
item.description: The Ethereum meme coin traded near $0.016 early Tuesday, about 23 times its November 5 low, yet still 45% below its October 31 record. Almost all trading runs through one Uniswap pool.

item.title: Janction (JCT) gives back most of its rally: down 65% from Sunday's record
item.description: JCT hit an all-time high near $0.0185 on Sunday afternoon. By early Tuesday it traded near $0.0065, down 26% in a day, though still more than twice its price before the surge.

item.title: Rumor vs record: a viral post credited to Musk said Binance holds 80% of crypto. It does not
item.description: A viral post credited to Elon Musk said Binance holds about 80% of the crypto market and urged users to leave. We checked each line against CoinGecko's exchange data and DeepSea's wallet tracker. The 80% figure does not hold up.

item.title: Zcash fell 9% in two days. Open bets on its six biggest futures markets fell 40%
item.description: ZEC slid from $1,279 to about $1,160 since November 8. Over the same stretch, open interest on Hyperliquid, OrangeX, CoinW, Gate, OKX and Bybit dropped from $2.51 billion to $1.50 billion, CoinGecko data show.

item.title: Initia's INIT jumped about 70% in a day, and traders swapped twice its market value
item.description: INIT climbed from about $0.12 to $0.22 in 24 hours, with $98 million to $102 million of trading against a market value under $50 million. Binance carried 43% of it, and a Turkish lira pair led every market.

item.title: Coinbase's cbBTC gained 2,921 bitcoin in 30 days. Lombard's LBTC lost 39% of its supply
item.description: Bitcoin is leaving most wrapped tokens on other chains, CoinGecko supply data shows. Coinbase's version was the exception, until it gave back 891 BTC in a day.

item.title: Hyperliquid's oil market fell 7% and a chip-stock market rose 21%. Crypto bets shrank $420M
item.description: Hyperliquid's crypto markets held $9.18 billion of open bets, down from $9.60 billion a day earlier. Its stock and commodity markets now hold a third of the total.

item.title: World Liberty's USD1 shrank 22% in 30 days, and USDC lost another $205 million on Monday
item.description: USD1 fell from $4.26 billion to $3.32 billion in a month, CoinGecko data shows. USDC kept leaking too, while USDT held flat for a second day.

item.title: A $93 million shark made 28,847 trades in 30 days, lost $162,000 and doubled its gold
item.description: Two days ago Hold91cc was up $26,100 on 12,787 trades. Now it has more than twice the trades, a loss, $18.77 million in Tether Gold and a $173,000 AAVE sale.

item.title: Smart money SM2b00 made $22 million on $13.29 billion of trades. Now it holds 15 shorts
item.description: SM2b00 is No. 4 on DeepSea's 7-day board at +$10.26 million. Its biggest bets are against ETH, SOL and HYPE, and CoinGecko prices show most of them in profit.

item.title: Influencer panceramic sold $351,000 of silver bets in 20 orders and went all cash
item.description: DeepSea shows 20 silver sell orders on Hyperliquid, then a wallet of $353,200 in USDC and no open bets. Ninety percent of the influencer's 30-day profit came this week.

item.title: Hong Kong moves to ban "crypto exchange" in the names of unlicensed firms
item.description: The Securities and Futures Commission has concluded its consultation on misleading business names. Any firm calling itself a crypto exchange, virtual asset market or token trading platform would need SFC approval first, six months after the law passes.

item.title: Allora's first cliff unlocks 160 million ALLO on November 11, about 38% of circulating supply
item.description: One year after launch, Allora's schedule frees a third of the tokens held by early backers and core contributors. At CoinGecko's price on November 9, that is about $23.6 million of new supply against a $62 million market cap.

item.title: The SEC's crypto capital and records rule for brokers reached the White House on November 3
item.description: A proposed SEC rule on how broker-dealers hold capital and keep records for crypto assets reached the White House regulatory office on November 3, 2026. The text is still private. Staff guidance shows where the agency has been heading.

item.title: Last week's worst crypto influencer is now No. 2 and holds a $13.4 million Zcash short
item.description: The KOL wallet mk4 was down $2.84 million for the week on November 5. DeepSea now shows +$2.24 million over seven days, but still minus $876,800 over 30.

item.title: The No. 1 smart money trader is short $474 million of crypto and up $45.7 million on paper
item.description: SMc060 retook first place on DeepSea's 7-day board with +$36.67 million. Its 19 open bets against BTC, ETH, ZEC and others are all in profit on paper.

item.title: Sharks sold $584,000 of ARB in a day, nearly 4 to 1, as the token edged up 1.1%
item.description: Four days after shark wallets bought $850,000 of Arbitrum's token, the flow reversed. One wallet also sold tokenized Circle shares in the last hour.

item.title: Unichain sharks sold $2.12 million of USD₮0, three days after sharks bought $3.74 million
item.description: The flow on Unichain's dollar token flipped. A wallet that was not among Friday's buyers did almost all the selling.

item.title: One Monad shark made 267 of 268 trades in a day. Its 30-day loss grew to $1.35 million
item.description: One wallet made almost every shark trade DeepSea tracked on Monad, cycling $7.1 million through two dollar tokens. Its losses keep growing.

item.title: Two Avalanche shark wallets made 580 small trades in bridged ETH and BTC as AVAX rose 8%
item.description: DeepSea's Avalanche shark feed looked crowded on Monday night. It was mostly two wallets swapping bridged ether and bitcoin back and forth in small pieces.

item.title: Pieverse (PIEVERSE) doubles in a week to a record $2.13 as Upbit leads trading
item.description: PIEVERSE rose 42% in 24 hours and 103% in seven days to a new all-time high on Monday. Upbit and Bithumb, two won-based exchanges, handled more than half of the $58.7 million traded.

item.title: Ether's 5% drop cut about $956 million from the 8.1 million ETH that public companies hold
item.description: CoinGecko lists 35 public companies with ether on their books, 32 with a balance. BitMine holds 74% of it, and 14 of the 15 firms with a listed cost are below it.

item.title: 429 sharks traded LINK in a day, triple any other Ethereum token, buying $14.1 million
item.description: Chainlink's token was the most crowded shark trade on Ethereum as ether fell 5%. Uniswap's UNI drew under a third as many wallets, and they were net sellers.

item.title: Nigeria sets a ₦15 billion floor for dollar stablecoin issuers and bans algorithmic coins
item.description: The Central Bank of Nigeria's new rules say foreign-currency stablecoins can reach Nigerians only through a locally licensed issuer. A foreign license does not count, and peer-to-peer desks need the bank's approval.

item.title: Trader SMb7ae made $11.5 million in a week, and 18 of its 20 open bets are shorts
item.description: SMb7ae is No. 5 on DeepSea's 7-day Smart Money board. Its open positions on Hyperliquid bet against bitcoin, HYPE, Starknet and 15 other tokens.

item.title: 80 sharks bought $8.1 million of Tether's gold token as ether fell 5%, while PAXG was sold
item.description: While ether dropped 5%, large wallets on DeepSea's live feed piled into XAUt. The rival gold token, PAXG, went the other way.

item.title: Senator Blumenthal gives Binance, Tether and World Liberty until January 4 to hand over records
item.description: Senator Richard Blumenthal says the three crypto firms have produced no records he asked for, some requests going back 18 months. His November 5 letters set a first check-in for November 9 and warn of "alternative measures" after January 4.

item.title: One shark put $49.7 million into Aave USDT as ether fell 5%, and holds $129 million in gold
item.description: The same shark wallet we covered on November 5 is back, buying Aave's USDT receipt in five steps. It also holds $129 million of tokenized gold, second only to its restaked ether.

item.title: Rumor vs record: Strategy's bitcoin is underwater, but no filing shows it must sell
item.description: Bitcoin slipped below Strategy's average purchase price overnight, and posts about a $54 billion bet gone bad spread fast. We checked each line against the company's own SEC filing and CoinGecko prices.

item.title: Solana launchpad token STONK fell 32% in a day and lost $45 million in under two days
item.description: StonkFun's STONK token dropped from about $0.10 to $0.044 between Saturday and Sunday evening, now 88% below its September record. Most of the trading ran through Solana DEX pools, CoinGecko's market list shows, and one Meteora pool handled nearly half of all trading.

item.title: Rumor vs record: did whales really load up on XRP as it slid to $1.10?
item.description: XRP fell 5.4% in a day and hit its lowest price since August. Posts say whales are buying the dip. We checked six viral claims. The price claims mostly hold up; the whale claims cannot be confirmed yet.

item.title: BlackRock's ether ETF lost 19% of its shares since September. Its bitcoin ETF held steady
item.description: ETHA, BlackRock's spot ether fund, held about 131.8 million shares on November 6, down from 162.4 million on September 30. That is roughly 693,000 ETH handed back, by our calculation, while the firm's bitcoin fund kept its share count flat.

item.title: One ether now buys 0.0286 bitcoin, the least since mid-July
item.description: Ether lost 2.7% against bitcoin in a day after Sunday's sell-off. CoinGecko's daily data shows no lower close since July 14.

item.title: Hyperliquid's crypto bets shrank $640 million since Friday, and ether shorts now pay
item.description: CoinGecko's per-market data puts Hyperliquid's open bets at $14.0 billion after Sunday's ether drop. Its $1.93 billion ether market now has negative funding, while bitcoin's does not.

item.title: Big stablecoins shrank another $1.5 billion since Friday. Sky's USDS lost $921 million
item.description: Eleven of the largest dollar tokens lost $1.54 billion in market value in three days, CoinGecko data shows. Ethena's USDe went the other way, up $412 million.

item.title: Shorts now pay longs on 77% of ether's open futures bets. On Friday it was 21.5%
item.description: After Sunday's 4.6% drop, funding turned negative on Binance's biggest ether market. Bitcoin barely moved: 1.4% of its bets lean short.

item.title: A shark bought $2.46 million of staked ether on Monad. DeepSea sees $116 of liquidity
item.description: The largest single shark buy of the last day came in three trades on ether's down day. The token's pools on Monad that DeepSea tracks hold only $116, so the buy did not run through them.

item.title: A smart money trader fell from No. 1 to No. 6. Two days later it is No. 2 with $23 million
item.description: SMc060's 7-day profit on DeepSea went from $59.67 million to $9.49 million and back up to $23.24 million. The top 10 now show $129.55 million, all on Hyperliquid.

item.title: Sharks sold $12.85 million of tokens and bought $7.98 million as ether fell 4.7%
item.description: DeepSea's live feed shows big wallets were net sellers on ether's down day. A dollar token on Optimism took most of the selling, and one Monad wallet bought $2.46 million of staked ether.

item.title: Nvidia's CEO told staff he was unfaithful. Tokenized Nvidia stock fell 7% at the open
item.description: Nvidia posted a memo from Jensen Huang on Sunday, November 8, and its board opened an independent investigation. On-chain Nvidia tokens fell 4.7% that evening, and after Monday's open the NVDAx token was still about 4.6% below Friday's close while a tokenized Nasdaq 100 fund rose.

item.title: Ether drops 4.6% in 20 minutes to $2,122 on Sunday afternoon, twice bitcoin's fall
item.description: ETH slid from about $2,224 to $2,122 between 4:40 and 5:00 p.m. ET on November 8, 2026, per CoinGecko. Bitcoin fell 2.2% in the same window. Ether is now down about 5% on the day and 14.5% over 30 days.

item.title: BlackRock's IBIT shrank $105 million on Friday, yet its share count is flat since September
item.description: IBIT, BlackRock's spot bitcoin fund, cut 2.44 million shares on November 6, about 1,380 BTC. Yet it has slightly more shares than on September 30, so nearly all of its $6.4 billion drop in assets since then came from bitcoin's price.

item.title: Janction (JCT) jumps 285% in a day to a record high as volume tops its market cap
item.description: JCT climbed from about $0.0025 to a new all-time high near $0.0107 on Sunday morning. About $175 million changed hands in a day, more than the token's $120 million market cap, and three venues handled 86% of it.

item.title: Hyperliquid holds $626 million of open Zcash bets, more than Binance's $556.9 million
item.description: On a quiet Sunday, Zcash was the second most traded market on Hyperliquid, ahead of ether. CoinGecko's data shows the on-chain exchange now carries the largest pile of open ZEC futures of any venue.
